response.overview: While traveling cross-country, a group of friends stop for the night at a secluded bed and breakfast tucked deep in the countryside. What begins as a quiet retreat quickly turns into chaos when they discover strange guests already staying on the property and an eccentric host whose behavior grows increasingly disturbing as the night unfolds. As tensions rise and paranoia sets in, the friends uncover a horrifying truth: the inn's owner is a reclusive author who uses real murder as inspiration for his work. Trapped inside the isolated estate with no easy way out, the group must survive their stay before they become the final chapter in his next story.
response.title: Evil by Design
